post.description:
Creates an account. Needs an invite code unless registration is open; with a code the
new user also joins that group (`joined_group`).
Ends the session that owns this refresh token. Always succeeds (idempotent).
Ends every session of the current user, including this one.
Changes the password, signs out all other sessions and returns new tokens for this one.

Deletes the account: owned groups go to the oldest admin (or member), or are deleted if
you are alone in them; you leave every group; your profile is anonymized.
Creates a group owned by the caller.
The target becomes owner; the caller becomes admin.

get.description: Owner, then admins, then members; each by name.

delete.description:
Removes a member, or leaves the group when ``user_id`` is the caller.

The only member leaving deletes the group.

get.description: Newest first (at most 100). Admins see every invite, members only their own.
Public: shows which group an invite is for and whether it can still be used.

post.description: Joins the group as a member. Accepting again when already a member changes nothing.
